richter_spruill.note: Fresh complete original H-Net1999review retrieved200 and reread. Richter’s own interpretation/public-history use is distinguished from quotations of Spruill’s1938preface/p208and mediated Scott1972/1998introductions. Specific praise for documented regional/status differences coexists with criticism that Black/Nativewomen are mentioned without sustained questions about their lives/work. Richter’s projected use for her slavery study remains an intention. Anne Firor Scott is not Joan Wallach Scott; Arthur M.Schlesinger Sr.is not Jr.; neither has a canonical person endpoint. Richter’s phrase borrowed from Beard and reported friendship do not prove Beard-to-Spruill transmission. Original1938book and Scott introductions remain unread as wholes; fresh1934Spruillarticle checked separately, not retroactively counted as full book reading.
